description: Officials pointed out that large amounts of data, including road alignment maps, Detailed Project Reports (DPRs), construction photographs, geo-tagged records and financial documents, are being generated regularly
body_lead: Bhubaneswar, July 22: In a move aimed at promoting the use of Artificial Intelligence (AI) in government administration, the Odisha Rural Development Department has proposed the procurement of premium digital services, including ChatGPT Plus, Google AI Pro and Google One. The proposal seeks administrative approval and financial sanction for acquiring advanced AI tools, cloud storage facilities and improved video conferencing solutions to enhance the efficiency of project management, online reviews and day-to-day administrative activities under the Pradhan Mantri Gram Sadak Yojana (PMGSY).
